method: Production application, disposable SQLite/backend JPEG/previews. Only user.personId in overview is injected for a linked account; family data and media are not mocked. Navigation timestamps are performance.now; resource counts are explicit allocations, not total VRAM. Mobile is Chrome touch emulation, not a physical phone. No GPU eligibility override. One run.
